sam: Heads up — prepping release notes + short internal announce for micro-release v0.9.3. Target change window: Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC (APAC-friendly). Draft below; need ops + docs sign-off. TL;DR: KV cache opt, dispatcher fix, pinned model variant rollout. Rollback plan: pin previous model and drain new pool.

sam: DRAFT RN/INTERNAL BLURB:

> Internal: v0.9.3 (rolled 2024-05-12 UTC) — quick maintenance release.
> - Fix: dispatcher race causing 5xx on cold starts (reduces error spike under burst).
> - Perf: KV-prefix caching improvements — ~8–12% token latency P95 improvement on long prompts.
> - Serving: pinned model variant "redwood-compact-q4" rollout for latency-sensitive routes.
>
> Impact: brief canary during change window. No DB migrations. Expected user-facing risk: low. If issues, rollback to v0.9.2 pinned model.

sam: Ops checklist (internal):
- 01:00 UTC: preflight smoke run against staging (smoke-id: smoke-1719).
- 01:40 UTC: merge release notes to internal doc + pin owners.
- 02:00 UTC: start canary (5% for 20m), monitor P95, 5xx, rps.
- If stable -> 50% 10m -> 100% ramp.
- If triggers -> run rollback job rb-20240512-01 and notify #incidents.

ivy: Looks good. Small nit: call out canary percent and fallback explicitly in the blurb. Also suggest adding deploy-bot cue snippet so ops can paste.

sam: Good call, adding now. Canary plan: 5% for 20m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. Fallback: immediate pin to v0.9.2 and scale down new pool.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window created for 2024-05-12T02:00:00Z. Suggested command:
```
/deploy release v0.9.3 --canary=5 --wait=20m --rollout=5,50,100
```
Will post statuses to this thread.

nate: Ops +1. Can we tighten rollback criteria: error rate > 1% (5xx) OR latency P95 increase > 200ms sustained for 5m. Also check kv cache hit ratio — if it drops unexpectedly, treat as trigger.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll be primary responder for the window. I'll have RB job ready:
- rollback id: rb-20240512-01
- quick command: `/run rollback rb-20240512-01`
I'll monitor dashboards (tokens: p95, 5xx, kv-hit). If triggered, I'll escalate to #incidents and notify infra leads.

maria: Docs updated: internal announce copy and a one-line user-facing blurb for comms. I trimmed the internal blurb to be shorter for #all-hands. Paste final copy here and I'll publish once deploy-bot reports success.

sam: Final internal announce copy (paste to #internal-announce when deploy shows 100%):

"Release v0.9.3 rolled during 02:00 UTC change window. Includes dispatcher cold-start fix, KV caching perf improvements, and a model variant pin for latency-sensitive routes. Canaryed at 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Ops monitored P95 and 5xx. Rollback criteria: 5xx >1% or P95 +200ms for 5m. Ops contact: @ops-oncall."

sam: If everyone is good here, i'll paste to #internal-announce ~02:25 UTC after canary passes and deploy-bot confirms. :thumbsup:

ivy: +1
nate: +1
maria: +1 — I'll publish the one-line to #all-hands after internal announce goes out.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 2024-05-12T02:00:00Z (5%). Will report back at milestones.

ops-oncall: On standby, monitoring dashboards.

sam: thanks all — will post final and close thread once 100% done. :party_parrot:
